newsitem.title: UK: UK Conservatives attack Labour's business plans.
newsitem.headline: UK Conservatives attack Labour's business plans.

text.p: Britain's ruling Conservatives said on Friday the opposition Labour Party's business manifesto would cost jobs and restore power to the trade unions.
Deputy Prime Minister Michael Heseltine said the so-called "windfall tax" on the excess profits of privatised utilities would not just penalise the companies but could increase prices and cost jobs.
"It is not the so-called fat cats who will suffer but the ordinary hard-working people of this country," Heseltine said.

Heseltine also criticised Labour for its attacks on the ruling party's European policy, saying this was an attempt to divert attention from Labour's business plans which he said would in fact damage rather than help the economy.
